title: it / one / that 的替代

examples.en: I can't find my pen. Have you seen it?
examples.zh: 我找不到我的笔了，你看见它了吗？

examples.en: I lost my pen, so I bought a new one.
examples.zh: 我把笔丢了，所以买了一支新的。

guess.question: 两句里说的“笔”有什么不同？

options.text: it 指的就是原来那一支；one 指的是同类的另一支
options.feedback: 对！it 是“就是它本人”，one 是“同款的另一个”。
不对——一支是找不着的那支，一支是新买的，不是同一支笔。
不对——it 不指人，指前面提到的那个事物本身。

left.label: it：同名同物
left.formula: it = 前面提到的那一个（就是它）

anchor.en: I can't find my pen. Have you seen it?
anchor.zh: 我找不到我的笔，你看见它了吗？

right.label: one：同类异物
right.formula: one = 同一类的另一个（a / an + 名词）

anchor.en: I lost my pen, so I bought a new one.
anchor.zh: 我把笔丢了，所以买了支新的。

right.focus: 新买的是另一支笔，只是同类

contrast.diff: it 是“同一个”，one 是“同款的另一个”。另外 that 常用于比较句中，替代前面提到的不可数名词或单数名词（The weather here is warmer than that in Beijing），避免重复。

traps.wrong: Your coat is nice. I want to buy it.
traps.right: Your coat is nice. I want to buy one.
traps.why: 想买的是同款的一件，不是你身上那件，用 one。

traps.wrong: The weather in Kunming is warmer than it in Beijing.
traps.right: The weather in Kunming is warmer than that in Beijing.
traps.why: 比较句中替代前面的不可数名词 weather 要用 that。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——it 指同一个，one 指同款另一个，比较句里替代用 that。

check.stem: — Did you see my dictionary? — Yes, I saw ____ on your desk.

options.distractor: one 是“另一本词典”，与语境不符
this 不用于替代前面提到的事物

check.explanation: 看见的就是“你那本词典” → it。

check.stem: Your bag is beautiful. I want to buy ____, too.

options.distractor: 不能买你那个包，是买同款的一个

options.text: The weather in Kunming is warmer than that in Beijing.
The weather in Kunming is warmer than it in Beijing.
options.distractor: 比较句里替代 weather 要用 that

options.text: The weather in Kunming is warmer than one in Beijing.
options.distractor: one 不能替代不可数名词

options.text: The weather in Kunming is warmer than this in Beijing.

check.explanation: 比较句中用 that 替代前面的 weather。
